column1: # Rows here override same-named rows in markers.tsv, for the nextbsd-userland
# workflows only. Same rule as overlay-nextbsd.tsv: declare a row only when
# this consumer must gate differently (an image that predates a capability
# the base table lists must-pass gets a warn here until it backports).

column6: T4: the userland native FreeBSD-based image REMOVED the fbsdglue file-existence checklist (nextbsd-userland#159 - it checked 25 Apple-port FreeBSD binaries this image does not ship; "emitted a marker nothing read ... removed rather than left as decoration"). The run.sh no longer emits FBSDGLUE, so it is warn here: a must-pass it never prints would fail the shared harness absence check on every userland boot. The nextbsd Apple image does emit it, so the base row stays must-pass for that consumer.
